nodes.label: /start
nodes.description:
🦆 Welcome to DUCK × MY × DUCK! 🦆

Hey there! This is a world where Ducks do the work for you.

Feed your Ducks to earn points. Breed them with friends to get new ones. Crack Eggs to find rare rewards. And hunt down the Legendary Ducks before they're all gone!

The most active players will receive special prizes when the big in-game event kicks off. The earlier you start — the better your chances of reaching the top.

Invite your friends — more fun, more rewards! 🎉
